A next-step sentence missing from the server falls back to the brief's sentence by code (texts.js). APPROVE: the Approve plan button now also shows when the next step is REVIEW_NEW_PLAN and the current plan is proposed (before, after a price change or refusal there was no way to approve the new version). IF SOMETHING FAILS: compensationOf now carries kind (void|refund) and says void queued, cancelled before authorization (voidedLocally), refund queued (captured with cancelRequested), declined, void failed / refund failed with 'contact the organiser'; a summary line 'Voids: n outstanding, n done. Refunds: n outstanding, n done.' (testid compensation-summary); the supplier's refusal reason is shown as text with dir=auto. (+ supplier still waiting), testid paypal-not-confirmed, no claim about money, gone once the order moved on or the plan ended. CONTRACT ASSUMPTION F1-a: after a supersession by price, fee or ready-time change, or after a supplier refusal, rescueStatus is status plan_found, rule 12, nextStep REVIEW_NEW_PLAN 'Review the new plan', message 'Prices changed: review plan vN' or 'Supplier X refused the order: <reason>. No money was taken.' (as derive.js does today); the new version is currentPlanId with status proposed and its own planHash; the UI approves it with that hash and total.

CONTRACT ASSUMPTION F1-b: while a re-plan is queued the view is status replanning, rule 4a, nextStep WAIT with text 'Finding a new plan with current stock…'; after five failed drains nextStep.code REPLAN 'Re-plan with current stock'. currentPlanId may be null while only superseded versions exist, and orders is [].

CONTRACT ASSUMPTION F1-c: an expired reservation reads reservation.status 'expired' (or message exactly 'Reservation expired — no money was taken; re-plan with current stock'), nextStep REPLAN. The Re-plan button calls POST /api/requests/:id/plan and expects 201 {planningRun, plan|null}; a 409 PLAN_IN_PROGRESS is shown as an error.

CONTRACT ASSUMPTION F1-d: a supplier refusal gives the refused Order refusalReason (text, up to 300 chars) and presentation 'refused'; while its voids are outstanding the older orders are in cancellingOrders with payment.cancelRequested true; an unsent void queued under cancelRequested shows as 'Void queued'. A real abandon gives presentation 'cancelled' and fulfilment 'cancelled' (not cancelled_payment_incomplete).

CONTRACT ASSUMPTION F2-a: Payment.cancelRequested, voidedLocally and voidFailed are exposed in RequestView.orders and cancellingOrders for every state (the text 'Cancelled before authorization' needs voidedLocally; 'contact the organiser' for a failed void needs voidFailed).

CONTRACT ASSUMPTION F2-b: after an admin refund_order the payment goes captured -> refund_requested/refund_pending -> refunded, the order presentation becomes 'refunded' once refunded, and rescueStatus follows rows 3, 5a and 7 with the exact messages 'Order from <supplier> was refunded by the organiser' and 'All payments were refunded by the organiser'. A captured payment with cancelRequested true is read as 'Refund queued'.

CONTRACT ASSUMPTION F2-c: POST /api/admin/faults answers {applied: {kind, ...}, superseded?: Id[]}; supplier_refusal applied carries supplierOrderIds (as src/services/admin.js does today; the spec only says '...ids'); refund_order applied carries supplierOrderId. POST /api/admin/reset with force answers {reset, archivedOperations, stranded?: {id, status, providerAuthorizationId?, providerCaptureId?}[]}; the UI shows the optional provider ids when present (the code today sends id and status only).

CONTRACT ASSUMPTION (return redirect): the return handler redirects to /#/requests/<id>?paypal=not_approved|check_failed&order=<soId> (src/services/payments.js redirectTo); the notice reads the order from the query.

For f4: stable data-testid hooks added: contact-organiser, compensation-summary (on compensation: data-state and data-kind), failure-<code>[-earlier]-refusal, success-plan, success-replan, paypal-not-confirmed, reset-stranded, input-refusalReason (the fault form's reason; input-reason is now the reset form's only), next-step-action (header button: Re-plan / Review the new plan), replan (the expired notice's button), approve-plan after REVIEW_NEW_PLAN. Admin fault rows carry the hidden attribute when not part of the chosen kind, so Playwright fill on a hidden control waits: choose the kind first.
The supplier Refuse button has no confirm dialog on purpose (a native confirm is auto-dismissed by Playwright and would make the click a no-op); the explicit reason form is the safeguard.
FU-40 UX is addressed for the case executed + live order still 'confirmed'; the journey-happy test still reloads before the receipt and was not edited (not my file).
Not done: no browser journey for the recovery states (f4 owns the browser tests); the 360 px layout was checked ad hoc only.
